**Hall Preparation and Move-In Procedures**

The process of preparing for resident move-in involves creating a welcoming and ready environment for both residents and their families. This includes ensuring that all spaces are clean and appropriately furnished, with all furniture set up correctly. Signage, such as bulletin boards, door tags, and wayfinding markers, should be in place to assist with navigation and orientation. Resident Assistants (RAs) play a crucial role during this time by being present to greet residents, assist with check-ins, and provide any necessary help. These steps are essential to ensure a smooth and positive move-in experience for everyone involved.

**Hall Preparation for Resident Move-In: Saturday, 8/16 & Sunday, 8/17**

**Resident Room Checks:**
- Verify the correct number of beds and furnishings are present according to the roster.
- Ensure beds and lofts are properly set up.
- Confirm room layouts are correctly arranged.
- Check the cleanliness of individual rooms and shared spaces within apartments or suites.
- Test that all room features and amenities are functioning properly.
- Ensure key and card access systems are operational.

**Common Space Checks:**
- Confirm that furnishings and layouts are correct.
- Assess cleanliness levels.
- Inspect for any damages or broken items.

**Signage and Community Preparations:**
- Post all required signage, including bulletin boards, door tags, and wayfinding signs.
- First-Year (FY) Communities should place a BedBev on every bed.

**Issue Resolution:**
- Address issues as they arise, such as vacuuming, wiping down surfaces, arranging or replacing furniture, etc.

**Planning and Scheduling:**
- The Community Director (CD) or Graduate Student Assistant (GSA) is responsible for setting the schedule and plan to complete hall preparation tasks efficiently.

**Item Drop & Early Arrivals: Saturday, 8/23 & Sunday, 8/24**

**Item Drop for First-Year Students (FY):**
- Item drop is available exclusively for first-year students, with no overnight stays permitted.
- Families must sign up for a time slot between 8:00 am and 4:00 pm.

**Early Arrivals for Second-Year (SY) and Upper-Division (UD) Students:**
- Eligible groups include Tommie Move-In Crew, GHR Fellows, Schultz Scholars, Welcome Days Leaders, Innovation Immersion participants, SJV, and International Students.

**Check-In Procedures:**
- Check-in tables will be staffed by individuals who have registered via SignUpGenius. These are paid shifts, open to Desk Staff and Resident Assistants (RAs) in SY Communities.
- RAs in both FY and SY Communities will assist in the residence halls, with schedules organized by the Community Director (CD) or Graduate Student Assistant (GSA).

**Check-In Locations:**
- Flynn Turnaround for Dowling, Brady, Flynn, and Morrison Halls
- Schoenecker North Garage for Ireland and Schoenecker Halls
- Frey Desk for Frey Hall (unstaffed)
- Murray Loading Dock for Murray Hall
- 51 Grand Lounge for Mid-Campus
- Grace Desk for South Campus

**Additional Information:**
- On Saturday, desks will operate with regular hours from 8:00 pm to 1:00 am.
- Regular RA duty will commence on Saturday from 4:30 pm to 8:00 am.
- Academic year meal plans will begin with brunch on Sunday.

**Early Arrivals - Monday, 8/25**

**Eligible Groups for Early Arrival:**
- Tommie Move-In Crew
- Tommie Ambassadors
- Innovation Immersion participants

**Check-In Procedures:**
- Check-in tables will be staffed by individuals who have signed up via SignUpGenius. These are paid shifts, and both Desk Staff and Resident Assistants (RAs) in First-Year (FY) Communities are eligible to participate.
- Resident Assistants in both First-Year (FY) and Second-Year (SY) Communities will assist in the residence halls. The Community Director (CD) or Graduate Student Assistant (GSA) is responsible for creating the schedule for these activities.

**Check-In Locations:**
- Flynn Turnaround for Dowling, Brady, Flynn, and Morrison Halls
- Schoenecker North Garage for Ireland and Schoenecker Halls
- Frey Desk for Frey Hall (Note: This location will not be staffed)
- Murray Loading Dock for Murray Hall
- 51 Grand Lounge for Mid-Campus residents
- Grace Desk for South Campus residents

**Communication Responsibilities:**
- RAs in FY Communities must send out FY Community Communication #7 via email.
- All RAs should audit the group chat and send a reminder email to their residents.

**Evening Activities:**
- STAR Bowling is scheduled as the evening activity for all early arrivals.

**Residence Life Operations: Move-In and Early Arrivals**

  - Frey Desk (serving Frey, not staffed)

  - 51 Grand Lounge (serving Mid-Campus)

- **Evening Activities**: RAs with LLCs are to go to dinner and connect with students (more details provided in handout). Activities include lawn games, an outdoor movie, bonfires, s’mores, and an LLC sweatshirt giveaway.

**Wednesday, 8/27: CGLC Move-In & Early Arrivals**

- **Participants**: All CGLC students.
- **Check-In Staffing**: Staffed by individuals who signed up via SignUpGenius for paid shifts. Eligible participants include Desk Staff and RAs in SY Communities.
- **RA Responsibilities**: RAs in FY and SY Communities assist in halls, with schedules created by CD/GSA.
- **Volunteers**: Tommie Move-In Crew volunteers will assist.
- **Check-In Locations**:
  - Flynn Turnaround (serving Dowling, Brady, Flynn, & Morrison)
  - Schoenecker North Garage (serving Ireland & Schoenecker)
  - Frey Desk (serving Frey, not staffed)
  - Murray Loading Dock (serving Murray)
  - 51 Grand Lounge (serving Mid-Campus)
  - Grace Desk (serving South Campus)
- **Additional Activities**: 
  - Begin "Eyeball" checks to ensure every resident has been physically seen by an RA or CD/GSA.

**SY & UD Arrivals and Welcome Days Schedule**

**Dates:** Thursday, August 28 – Tuesday, September 2

**Activities:**
- **Welcome Days:** For more information, visit [Welcome Days 2025](https://stuaffairs.aflip.in/WelcomeDays2025#page/1).
- **SY & UD Arrivals:** Scheduled daily from 8 am to 8 pm.

**Check-In Process:**
- **Locations:**
  - Flynn Lobby
  - Morrison 2nd Floor Lobby
  - Frey Desk
  - 51G Lounge (Mid-Campus)
  - Grace Desk

- **Staffing:**
  - Resident Assistants (RAs) will staff check-in tables in SY Communities. The Community Director (CD) or Graduate Student Assistant (GSA) will create the staffing schedule.
  - FY Communities will have signage and RA staffing to assist with late arrivals.

**Important Dates and Meetings:**

- **September 1:** FY Roommate Agreements are due.
- **September 2:**
  - 11 am: All RAs are required to attend the March Through the Arches event.
  - 7 pm: SY Community Meeting #1.
- **September 7:** SY Roommate Agreements are due.
